verdict.rationale: Reflect has an OAuth 2 API, including PKCE, that can append data to notes and list bookmarked links, and it connects to Zapier. Together these allow some headless, scripted automation without the app UI. The API is described as limited ('a few other things'), deep links still need the app, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: a CLI or documented headless/CI mode, a full read/write API surface, a published API spec, and hands-on corroboration of automated use.
